[[File:Anthony Howard 2020 Volunteer Award.jpg|thumb|right|260px|With the 2020 Volunteer Award.]]
'''Anthony Howard''' (GEMP handle '''batmouse''') is a member of the [[Killer Bees]]. He finished '''10th''' in [[2022 Retro League Event 1|Event 1 of the 2022 Retro League]].<ref name="p1367981" /> Howard also finished '''#14''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 16; Challonge seed 21).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
